Maria (Finance): FYI Acme flagged invoice 2026-03 for an unexpected embed units spike. They say usage patterns didn't change on their side. Can we triage? /cc @Oliver
Oliver (Acct Mgr): Noted — looping in eng & billing. Any quick numbers we can share with the customer?
Billing Bot: Invoice=2026-03 customer_id=acme-corp embed_units=3,412,000 token_count=0 billable_amount=$1,365.00
Kevin (Platform): I see a tokenizer release rolled 2026-03-01 (sha=a1b2c3). It changed emoji/whitespace normalization which can affect embedding unit counts. Investigating metering pipeline now. :eyes:
Ashwin (Eng): Running a targeted query for acme-corp 2026-03-01..2026-03-10 to sample raw events.
Ashwin (Eng): ```
SELECT event_time, request_id, model, embed_units, raw_text_length
FROM metering.events
WHERE customer_id='acme-corp' AND event_time >= '2026-03-01'
ORDER BY event_time LIMIT 5;
```
Kevin (Platform): Quick sample shows per-request embed_units jumped ~3x after the tokenizer change. Eg request_id=xyz: embed_units 12 -> 36 post-rollout. Looks correlated with emoji splitting.
Maria (Finance): Customer is adamant they didn't change prompts. From a billing policy standpoint, is this considered billable or do we need to offer a credit?
Ashwin (Eng): Two paths: (A) classify as a regression caused by our tokenizer change and offer a credit for the delta; (B) consider it an expected change in tokenization and only provide a one-time courtesy. Need Finance/Acct sign-off.
Finance Ops: If we credit, what's the order of magnitude? Need delta units + $ impact before approving.
Kevin (Platform): Ran an aggregate diff: delta_embed_units (post - expected) ~= 2,245,000 units for March window. Using current embed rate $0.0004/unit => estimated refund ~$898.
Oliver (Acct Mgr): I'll propose a goodwill credit of $900 and document it as caused by tokenizer normalization change. Maria, can you approve?
Maria (Finance): Approve $900 credit. Also request engineering add a post-deploy metric & alert: per-customer embed multiplier >1.5x sustained for 10m after tokenizer/model deploy. :thumbsup:
Ashwin (Eng): Created ENG-5234: "tokenizer-release: detect per-customer embed multiplier regressions". Includes rollback playbook and broader sweep to find impacted customers. Link: https://company.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-5234
Billing Bot: Credit queued: amount=$900 invoice=2026-03 customer_id=acme-corp ref=ACME-CREDIT-1938675300 status=queued
